# `calendar`

A realm's calendar (09 §14.2): the names of the parts of its day, each from a time of day, and the length of its year with the names of its seasons. The day's length and the time its clock starts at are the sky's.

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `parts` (list of object [`DayPartDef`](#daypartdef); optional): The parts of the day, in order of when each begins; the first part also runs from midnight to its `from` if that is later, and the last until midnight.
- `year` (whole number, 0 or more; optional): How many days a year has. 0 or left out: there is no year, and no season.
- `seasons` (list of object [`SeasonDef`](#seasondef); optional): The seasons, in order of the day each begins on.
- `doc` (string, or `null`; optional): What it is, for the reference.

<a id="daypartdef"></a>
### `DayPartDef`

A part of the day: its name and when it begins.

- `name` (string; **required**): Its name, as rules read it: `dawn`, `night`.
- `from` (string; **required**): When it begins: `"HH:MM"` of a twenty-four hour day.

<a id="seasondef"></a>
### `SeasonDef`

A season: its name and the day of the year it begins on.

- `name` (string; **required**): Its name, as rules read it.
- `from` (whole number, 0 or more; **required**): The day of the year it begins on, counted from 0.
